description: (0.5.0) Change-hint subscriptions and webhooks (RFC-ACDP-0018 §8). Scenarios A–C and F–H are registry-side (acdp-registry-events); D–E are receiver-side (acdp-consumer-recall). Carries one executed HMAC known-answer vector (hint-hmac-001).

expected.behavior: Authenticated POST /subscriptions returns 201 with acdp-subscription.schema.json, status active, and a secret of >= 32 bytes; GET returns the same object without secret; DELETE returns 204, then GET is not_found.
other_requester GETs or DELETEs the subscription; unauthenticated POST gives not_authorized (403).
After a matching visible change, the callback receives an acdp-change-hint/1 body with no change content and a valid ACDP-Signature t=…,v1=HMAC-SHA-256(secret, t + '.' + body).
A receiver rejects a hint with a wrong v1, and one whose t is more than 300 s from its clock.
On a hint the receiver requests GET /changes?since=<its persisted cursor> with the subscription filter, never head_cursor.
callback_url http://…, https://127.0.0.1/…, https://[::1]/…, https://169.254.169.254/…, or a host resolving to RFC 1918 space is rejected.
A callback host that re-resolves to a private address after creation receives no delivery; redirects are not followed.
A change not visible to the owner produces no hint.

vectors.name: hint-hmac-001
vectors._note: Key = the UTF-8 bytes of the secret string exactly as served, NOT its base64 decoding (not_header shows the decoded-key MAC, which MUST NOT verify). Body = the raw request bytes (here the JCS form of examples/change-hint/golden-hint.json; the registry MAY send any byte form, the MAC is over what is sent). RFC-ACDP-0018 §8.2.
